name: Abyss Outpost: Auto Frontline
description:
About This Game

Explore the Abyss Rifts to scan and collect data from countless foes, turning them into printable battle cards. Whether they are native Abyssal Aberrations or interdimensional soldiers drawn into the rifts, all can be enlisted to join your legion.

                          

Lurking within the Abyss Rifts are enemies from countless worlds: Abyssal Aberrations, knight legions from medieval realms, and arcane masters from magical civilizations. Defeat them to unlock new battle cards and cores, and forge endlessly diverse playstyles and builds.

                          

Equip distinct gear and runes to create unique combat effects, and construct your exclusive frontline. Powered by the Energy Core, you will automatically summon massive legions for hands-off, fully auto-battler confrontations, enjoying the dual thrill of strategic building and fast-paced combat.

Venture through randomized Abyss dungeons, where each level features random shops, black markets, taverns, and core enhancements. Manage your resources, choose your upgrade path, and experience the thrill of deep, progressively challenging roguelike progression.

Back at your Abyss Outpost, you can browse unlocked unit archives, spend Abyss Circuits to permanently upgrade your Console, and unlock additional battle cards, gear, and runes. Every challenge will make your legion stronger than before.

                          

Descend into the Abyss, build your automated frontline, and forge your legend in the depths!
short_desc: A strategic roguelike auto-battler. Explore the abyss, gather unit data, and print battle cards. Combine unique gear and runes to build an unbreakable automated front, deploying entity armies via your Energy Core. Fend off brutal bosses, shatter enemy lines, and forge your legend within the abyss!
